title: 第177章 百里坟一第176章 是我说的
content_zh:
沈二握着棒骨的手停了一瞬，差点没绷住表情，在心里飞快地算了一笔账：
光是那几瓶丹药，就够她修炼好一阵子了，更别提那几件法器，虽然她看不太懂品阶，但灵气的纯度摆在那里，绝不是大路货。
她压下嘴角，清了清嗓子：“还行吧，勉勉强强够。”
说完，又觉得自己这话说得有点心虚，补了一句：“不过你们天玄宗的人，应该不止这点家底吧？”
裴易没有接话，侧首看着她，连带着身后萧武和齐仓的虎视眈眈，让沈二意识到，该见好就收。原本就是想着帮唐渺出口气，现在连带着这些宝贝，算是赚了。
“行吧，做人留一线，日后好相见，东西我收下，你们可以走了。”沈二把东西收入空间，朝姜水依的方向偏了偏头。
挟持姜水依的少年会意，一掌把姜水依推开，跟着沈二拔腿就跑。
得了自由的姜水依第一时间跑回裴易身边，清丽脸庞宛若出水芙蓉，“风容哥哥……”
不知怎的，裴易有种头皮发麻的感觉，浑身不自觉起鸡皮疙瘩，他细细反思，之前怎么没觉得这个称呼如此膈应。
萧武凑上来，“就这么放他们走了？”
裴易回过神，看着他们消失的方向，不知想到什么，轻笑出声，“一些身外之物罢了，权当接济贫苦，给自己积德。”
“裴师兄果真是圣人之心。”萧武竖起大拇指。
“别贫，修整一下，继续赶路。”裴易将掉在地上的纱帽捡起来，抖去上面的灰尘，却发现上面多了个脚印。
裴易默了默，“罢了，回头再寻件新的。”
姜水依乖巧地点点头。
唐渺回想起方才那两个身影，越想越觉得眼熟。
……
“怎么样怎么样？”虞繁花第一个跳出来迎接他们。
“呼——”沈二一把将人皮面具撕下，脸上通红冒汗，她咧嘴一笑，“安衍把她帽子掀了，我还趁乱踩了一脚。”
“好！”虞繁花两手一拍，“让她欺负猫猫。”

“就是！”
人欺负了，还获得许多盘缠，接下来的节点可以说完全不用为钱发愁。
安衍这边直接用术法换回之前的打扮，人皮面具拿在手中，“我们原地修整，等他们走远我们再赶路，以免再碰上。”
方才在蜘蛛洞里跑了半天，沈二已是饥肠辘辘，能休息再好不过。
韩执旭欣然同意，“我去找柴火生火。”
“我也去。”虞繁花主动跟上。
“唉——”沈二舒了口气，寻个合适的地方躺下，闭上眼准备眯一会儿。
过了几息，她发觉不对，猛地坐起身，蹭了蹭胳膊，不是因为冷，是那种透骨的阴凉。
“这地方阴气怎么那么重？”
百里识越答道：“前面不远是百里坟，阴气不重才怪。”
安衍：“！”
沈二：“什么坟？？！！”
百里识越以为她是有所误会，解释道：“是百里坟田，不是我百里家的坟。继西属大战之后，人族各国那么多年没少围剿妖族，打仗肯定会死人，尸体肯定要找地方处理，所以便有了百里坟。”
“不过你们不用怕，我过来的时候还在那边留宿过，顶多有几个低阶的孤魂野鬼。”
“倒不是因为怕……”沈二扶额，她现在完全不敢去看安衍的眼睛，“我累了，我要睡一会儿。”
百里识越看向她，“不吃东西了？方才你那条蛇逮了几只野鸡，我们正商量着等你们回来做烧鸡吃呢。”
沈二：“……”
content_en:
Shen Er's hand holding the stick paused for a moment, almost losing his expression, and he quickly made a calculation in his mind:
Those few bottles of elixirs alone were enough for her to practice for a while, not to mention the few magic weapons. Although she couldn't understand the grades, the purity of the spiritual energy was definitely not a common commodity.
She lowered the corners of her mouth and cleared her throat: "It's okay, barely enough."
After saying that, he felt that what he said was a little guilty, so he added: "But you Tianxuan Sect people should have more than this, right?"
Pei Yi didn't answer, and looked at her sideways, along with Xiao Wu and Qi Cang's eager glances behind him, making Shen Er realize that it was time to give up. Originally, he just wanted to help Tang Miao vent his anger, but now he has made a profit with these treasures.
"Okay, let's keep a line in our lives so that we can meet again in the future. I'll take the things and you can go." Shen Er put the things into the space and tilted his head in the direction of Jiang Shuiyi.
The young man holding Jiang Shuiyi understood, pushed Jiang Shuiyi away with one palm, and ran away with Shen Er.
After being freed, Jiang Shuiyi immediately ran back to Pei Yi, her beautiful face like a hibiscus rising from water, "Brother Fengrong..."
For some reason, Pei Yi felt like his scalp was numb and goosebumps appeared all over his body. He reflected carefully on why he had never felt that this title was so inappropriate before.
Xiao Wu came up and asked, "Just let them go like this?"
Pei Yi came back to his senses and looked at the direction in which they disappeared. He didn't know what he thought of and chuckled softly, "It's just some external things. You should help the poor and accumulate virtue for yourself."
"Senior Brother Pei really has the heart of a saint." Xiao Wu gave a thumbs up.
"Don't be poor, fix it and continue on your way." Pei Yi picked up the gauze hat that fell on the ground and shook off the dust, only to find that there were more footprints on it.
Pei Yi was silent, "That's it, I'll look for a new one later."
Jiang Shuiyi nodded obediently.
Tang Miao recalled the two figures just now, and the more he thought about them, the more familiar they seemed.
…
"How are you doing?" Yu Fanhua was the first to jump out to greet them.
"Huh -" Shen Er ripped off the human skin mask, her face was red and sweating, she grinned, "Anyan lifted her hat, and I stepped on her."
"Okay!" Yu Fanhua clapped her hands, "Let her bully Maomao."
"That's right!"
I was bullied and got a lot of money. It can be said that there is no need to worry about money at the next node.
Anyan directly used magic to change back to his previous appearance, holding the human skin mask in his hand, "Let's repair it on the spot, and wait until they are far away before we continue on our way to avoid running into them again."
After running around in the spider cave for a long time, Shen Er was already very hungry and it would be great to rest.
Han Zhixu readily agreed, "I'll go find firewood to make a fire."
"I'll go too." Yu Fanhua took the initiative to follow.
"Oh -" Shen Er breathed a sigh of relief, found a suitable place to lie down, closed his eyes and prepared to squint for a while.
After a few breaths, she realized something was wrong. She sat up suddenly and rubbed her arm. It was not because of the cold, but because of the bone-deep coolness.
"Why is this place so dark?"
Baili Shiyue replied: "Not far ahead is Baili Tomb. It's strange that the yin energy is not strong."
Anyan: "!"
Shen Er: "What grave??!!"
Baili Shiyue thought she had misunderstood, and explained: "It's Baili Cemetery, not the grave of my Baili family. After the Spanish War, the human race countries have been encircling and suppressing the demon clan for so many years. People will definitely die in wars, and the bodies must be found somewhere to dispose of them, so there is Baili Cemetery."
"But you don't have to be afraid. I stayed there when I came here. There were at most a few low-level ghosts."
"It's not because of fear..." Shen Er held her forehead, she didn't dare to look into Anyan's eyes now, "I'm tired, I want to sleep for a while."
Baili Shiyue looked at her, "Don't want to eat? Your snake just caught a few pheasants, and we are discussing how to cook roast chicken when you come back.""
Shen Er: "..."
